About the job
About Narya.ai



At Narya.ai, we are driving the future of AI innovation, founded by AI researchers from Caltech and Georgia Tech. Our mission is to create cutting-edge productivity tools that enable users to capture ideas, organize information, build personal knowledge networks, and manage complex tasks. By developing AI products that enhance human capabilities, we aim to improve daily efficiency and well-being for our users.



We are currently building Mumble Note (https://www.mumblenote.com/), an AI-powered voice note app. Mumble Note transforms your thoughts and moments into structured notes with AI, organizes them for easy retrieval and review, and allows seamless sharing. The app is currently in beta testing.



About the Role: Machine Learning Research Engineer



We are seeking a Machine Learning Research Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will work on building innovative AI solutions and collaborating with a talented team to:

 • Design and implement AI systems that address user needs in innovative ways.

 • Build data pipelines, fine-tune multimodal language models, and develop AI agents by integrating and coordinating various models.

 • Improve models and algorithms based on user feedback to enhance product performance.



This position is available as a full-time role or internship based in Palo Alto.



Requirements



We are looking for candidates who possess the following qualifications:

 • Proficiency in implementing algorithm ideas into functional code.

 • Demonstrated experience in machine learning and working with large language models (LLMs).

 • Strong problem-solving skills and a drive to tackle challenging issues.



Compensation

Compensation and benefits will be discussed during the interview process and will be commensurate with experience and role type (full-time or internship).



Application

If you are passionate about shaping the future of AI, we encourage you to apply. Please send your resume or questions to jobs@narya.ai.
